title: China-to-Peru Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Peru relies on INACAL-adopted NTP technical standards (including IEC 62841-aligned references for hand-held and transportable power tools) and any category-specific Reglamento Tecnico published via PRODUCE/INDECOPI. For models under a mandatory technical regulation, a conformity certificate is required at import stage. For corded tools and chargers, electrical safety expectations are aligned to the INACAL/NTP framework and tested against Peru-relevant grid conditions at 220 V, 60 Hz.
target_standards: INACAL NTP standards aligned with IEC 62841 for hand-held and transportable power tools
PRODUCE/INDECOPI Reglamento Tecnico where issued and applicable by category
2026-06-15: INACAL and INDECOPI official guidance on scope of technical regulations
rows.china_equivalent: China uses the GB/T 3883 family as the standard technical baseline for tool electrical safety and often separate charger safety routes, with CCC where required. These reports are useful technical evidence but do not replace the Peru destination import conformity model that depends on INACAL-adopted requirements and regulator-facing documentation.
china_standards: China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: The frequent gap is treating GB/T/CCC reports as Peru-ready evidence. Exporters should separate tool body and charger scope, confirm model-level applicability of any Peru Reglamente Tecnico, and add 220 V 60 Hz suitability and importer-facing conformity scope before shipment.

target.en: Mandatory when a mandatory Reglamento Tecnico covers the product category; compliance evidence and declared importability are required in addition to any voluntary NTP alignment. No CE mandatory pathway is used in Peru.
target.zh: 若某产品类别受强制性技术规章覆盖，则符合性证明和进口申报要求是强制的；若未被规章覆盖，则  NTP 更多是技术参考。秘鲁不采用 CE 强制路径。
target.zht: 若某產品類別受強制性技術規章覆蓋，則符合性證明和進口申報要求是強制的；若未被規章覆蓋，則 NTP 更多是技術參考。祕魯不採用 CE 強制路徑。

cn.en: China domestic requirement commonly relies on GB/T 3883 and CCC in applicable categories.
cn.zh: 中国境内通常依 GB/T 3883 及适用类别的 CCC 要求执行。
cn.zht: 中國境內通常依 GB/T 3883 及適用類別的 CCC 要求執行。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Peru-ready until model-level electrical scope is mapped to applicable Peru regulations and 220 V 60 Hz entry conditions are shown in importer-facing technical files. GB/T/CCC outputs are useful but insufficient alone.

rows.requirement: Electromagnetic and radio compliance, including cordless equipment
rows.target_requirement: Peru does not run a CE-like single mandatory EMC law for all power tools. Non-radio models are handled through product-specific NTP or applicable technical regulation scope. Any cordless model with wireless function (Bluetooth, WiFi module, remote control, NFC, or similar transmitter) requires MTC homologation and registry approval before the model may be marketed or used.
target_standards: MTC equipment homologation for transmitter-capable products before market placement
No standalone mandatory EMC Directive equivalent for all power tools
rows.china_equivalent: China uses GB/T 9254 series and related EMI testing for many electronics, and radio modules with transmitter functions need SRRC approval under domestic spectrum rules. This does not replace Peru MTC homologation requirements, which are model- and market-specific.
rows.gap: The gap is usually one of scope and homologation model. A China SRRC or GB/T EMC report may support engineering review, but Peru requires a separate MTC homologation step for cordless models with transmitters. Non-radio models without a transmission function do not need radio homologation but still need the import regulatory pathway.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation only where the model has wireless transmission: MTC homologation and model registration before market entry. No standalone mandatory CE-style EMC mark for non-radio power tools.
target.zh: 若产品带无线发射功能，则 MTC 型号核准与型号注册是强制义务；非无线电电动工具不存在 CE 式独立 EMC 标志强制。
target.zht: 若產品帶無線發射功能，則 MTC 型號核准與型號註冊是強制義務；非無線電電動工具不存在 CE 式獨立 EMC 標誌強制。

cn.en: China GB/T and SRRC evidence is common technical evidence where applicable, but is not equivalent to Peru MTC obligations.
cn.zh: 中国 GB/T 与 SRRC 证据常见于技术证据，但不等同于秘鲁 MTC 义务。
cn.zht: 中國 GB/T 與 SRRC 證據常見於技術證據，但不等同於祕魯 MTC 義務。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Peru-ready for radio-capable cordless tools until MTC homologation and registry listing are completed for each marketed model. Non-radio models still need import-regulation mapping and importer accountability, but do not have a separate mandatory EU-style EMC mark.

rows.requirement: Market access: importer of record and customs workflow
rows.target_requirement: Peru market placement for power tools is importer-driven. The responsible in-country importer owns SUNAT customs filing and release, typically via Callao port, and bears local compliance follow-up. Importers must support mandatory technical documentation where a PRODUCE/INDECOPI Reglamento Tecnico applies to the product category. INDECOPI consumer protection expectations require Spanish product and importer information, and energy-efficiency labelling is assessed only when a product falls in MINEM’s scope. General RAEE waste handling applies at distributor level, not as a dedicated power-tool passport process.
target_standards: PRODUCE/INDECOPI Reglamento Tecnico regime and mandatory conformity paths
INDECOPI consumer information and importer attribution requirements
SUNAT customs clearance via Callao for imported goods
rows.china_equivalent: China-side export files usually manage export declaration and domestic quality evidence around China labelling, GB/T reports, and CCC where required. These are not equivalent to Peru importer-of-record and local customs-channel obligations.
china_standards: GB/T electrical safety reports and CCC where applicable
China export declaration and customs documentation rules
rows.gap: A common Peru gap is assuming domestic Chinese market files are reusable as-is. Peru needs a local importer-linked filing model, Spanish labeling obligations, and regulator-facing evidence mapped to category applicability before customs release through Callao.

target.en: Mandatory legal obligation: Peru-established importer of record, SUNAT customs process through Callao, and any category-specific technical-conformity obligations; no CE mark is used as a market-access basis.
target.zh: 强制义务：具备秘鲁境内进口商主体、依SUNAT卡亚俄通关流程，并满足产品类别对应的技术合规要求；未采用 CE 标记作为市场准入基础。
target.zht: 強制義務：具備祕魯境內進口商主體、依 SUNAT 卡亞俄通關流程，並滿足產品類別對應的技術合規要求；未採用 CE 標籤作為市場准入基礎。

cn.en: China domestic market access depends on export declaration and CCC/GB filing, which does not create Peru importer or SUNAT-role compliance.
cn.zh: 中国国内市场准入依赖出口报关和 CCC/GB 资料，这不构成秘鲁进口商或 SUNAT 角色的合规替代。
cn.zht: 中國國內市場准入依賴出口報關和 CCC/GB 資料，這不構成祕魯進口商或 SUNAT 角色的合規替代。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Peru-ready until importer-linked customs ownership, importer information in Spanish-facing documentation, and category-based Reglamento Tecnico obligations are completed through the Callao/SUNAT route. Chinese domestic export files are a useful start but are not destination-ready by themselves.

source.publisher: INDECOPI / SUNAT guidance and technical regulation references

rows.requirement: Noise: no EU-style outdoor-noise product marking
rows.target_requirement: Peru does not run a power-tool regime equivalent to the EU outdoor-noise emission marking and guaranteed sound-power model. Noise exposure controls are generally treated through occupational and workplace safety expectations and environmental governance, with MTPE and related sectoral inspectors enforcing use-site compliance rather than a tool-placed noise declaration label.
target_standards: MTPE occupational safety and noise-exposure governance
No standalone mandatory EU-style outdoor-noise marking regime for power tools in Peru
rows.china_equivalent: China also treats noise largely through product-testing and workplace/industrial control frameworks, and does not use an EU-style mandatory guaranteed sound-power labeling regime for all power tools. The two systems are not directly equivalent in paperwork terms.
china_standards: GB/T workplace and product noise test standards where applicable
China domestic workplace noise exposure control
rows.gap: The clear gap is no product-level noise-marking gap to close for Peru. Exporters should avoid presenting EU-style outdoor-noise evidence as a mandatory Peruvian market-access duty, and should instead document that any workplace or use-site noise controls are managed by the importer/customer context.

target.en: No mandatory EU-style guaranteed sound-power noise-marking obligation on power tools in Peru. Occupational noise control is context-specific and not a tool-level declaration gate.
target.zh: 秘鲁对电动工具不存在欧盟式的强制性保证声功率产品标识。职业噪声控制是场景化义务，不属于工具层面的市场准入宣示。
target.zht: 祕魯對電動工具不存在歐盟式的強制性保證聲功率產品標識。職業噪聲控制是場景化義務，不屬於工具層面的市場准入宣示。

cn.en: China technical files generally provide test values and workplace controls but these are not a substitute for Peru importer-level obligations.
cn.zh: 中国技术文件通常提供测试值和工作场所控制安排，但这不能替代秘鲁进口商层面的义务。
cn.zht: 中國技術文件通常提供測試值和工作場所控制安排，但這不能替代祕魯進口商層面的義務。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] There is no Peru product-label noise duty equivalent to EU Directive-style outdoor noise marking. Do not treat EU noise test artifacts as mandatory Peru market-entry evidence; map site-level occupational controls through importer documentation instead.

source.publisher: Ministerio de Trabajo y Promocion del Empleo (MTPE)

rows.target_requirement: Peru does not have a single Peru-wide RoHS-like mandatory restricted-substances regime that applies automatically to all power tools as a market entry gate. Substance control is handled through sectoral environmental, waste, and consumer product rules rather than one horizontal marking law. Compliance teams still commonly apply material declarations and supplier controls, but this is contractual or sectoral, not a universal Peru RoHS process for every imported power tool.
target_standards: No Peru-wide RoHS-equivalent horizontal prohibited-substances law
MINAM and INDECOPI environmental/waste and consumer interfaces where substance control can be triggered
rows.china_equivalent: China RoHS reporting and GB/T material evidence can support supplier control, but Peru does not treat the same declaration format as a single mandatory destination legal test for all tools. Exporters should re-map substance evidence to Peruvian commercial and regulatory context by category.
rows.gap: The gap is mostly interpretive: no Peru EU-style marked RoHS duty means the wrong risk is over-reading EU documentation as a Peruvian legal gate. Exporters should still collect robust material evidence where Peru import customers or downstream buyers require it.

target.en: No mandatory Peru-wide horizontal RoHS-style restricted substances regime for power-tool market entry.
target.zh: 秘鲁没有覆盖电动工具入场的全国性 RoHS 式横向限用物质制度。
target.zht: 祕魯沒有覆蓋電動工具入場的全國性 RoHS 式橫向限用物質制度。

cn.en: China RoHS evidence is domestic and often contractual but useful for supplier control in export planning.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 证据属于国内及合同性内容，在出口筹划中可用于供应链控制。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 證據屬於國內及合同性內容，在出口籌劃中可用於供應鏈控制。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat RoHS-like declarations as commercial and category-based controls, not a mandatory Peru entry condition for all power tools. A generic EU RoHS file is not equivalent to Peru market admission evidence.

rows.requirement: Battery regulation framework and passport model
rows.target_requirement: Peru does not operate a horizontal battery regulation system equivalent to EU battery laws for destination clearance. There is no mandatory battery passport, no EU-style removability or carbon-footprint labelling requirement, and no universal chemistry-based due diligence regime for battery substances at the Peru import gate. Battery obligations are fulfilled through sector-specific instruments: NTP-aligned safety evidence where a mandatory technical regulation applies, MTC checks for wireless-capable cordless products, and transport dangerous-goods handling.
target_standards: No EU-style horizontal battery law equivalent in Peru
INACAL NTP safety references where relevant
rows.china_equivalent: China requires safety evidence such as GB 31241 and CCC where applicable for some rechargeable-battery product classes, and has its own hazardous-waste and recycling obligations. These are domestic equivalents in structure but are not Peru battery passport requirements.
china_standards: China domestic recycling and waste obligations
rows.gap: A common mistake is requiring EU-style battery passport, carbon-footprint, or critical-mineral chain-due-diligence documents for Peru placement. For this lane, those EU-style requirements generally do not apply. The practical gap is category-by-category technical-conformity and importer-linked compliance, not passport paperwork.

target.en: No Peru horizontal EU-style battery passport or chemistry-level due diligence law is in force for market clearance. Mandatory duties are route and category based, with NTP/Reglamento Tecnico scope and MTC where applicable.
target.zh: 秘鲁市场通道不存在横向的欧盟式电池护照或按化学体系尽职调查法。强制义务为类别和路径导向，体现为技术规章/NTP 范围及必要时的 MTC 要求。
target.zht: 祕魯市場通道不存在橫向的歐盟式電池護照或按化學體系盡職調查法。強制義務為類別和路徑導向，體現為技術規章/NTP 範圍及必要時的 MTC 要求。

cn.en: China battery safety certifications are domestic and do not transfer as a Peru battery passport requirement.
cn.zh: 中国的电池安全证书属于国内体系，不会自动转化为秘鲁电池护照要求。
cn.zht: 中國的電池安全證書屬於國內體系，不會自動轉化為祕魯電池護照要求。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] There is no EU-style battery passport or chemistry-wide mandatory battery model for Peru. Exporters should avoid overbuilding passport documentation and instead verify category-specific technical obligations, MTC, and importer-led customs/compliance flow.

source.publisher: INACAL / INDECOPI and energy-management references for Peru
